case_study_title: 🏛️ Benchmark Case Study: Tata Steel 26.6% Stake Dilution (-20% Crash / 1800 PE +72,400% Surge)
source: NSE Corporate Disclosure & Historical Case Study
headline: Strategic agreement with Tata Steel for 26.6% stake acquisition and tubes business transfer
details: Tata Steel acquired 26.6% promoter stake for ₹15,510 Cr @ ₹2,100 per share with transfer of pipes business. Market feared severe minority shareholder dilution and loss of premium valuation, triggering a 20% crash to ₹1,655; 1800 PE surged +72,400% from ₹0.20 to ₹145.

news_summary.key_event: Tata Steel acquired 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo Tubes with corporate restructuring of tubes business.
news_summary.financial_quantum: ₹15,510 crore at ₹2,100 per share; 26.6% equity dilution for existing shareholders.
news_summary.strategic_context: Market perceived loss of standalone agility, minority shareholder dilution, and valuation de-rating.

sentiment_analysis.rationale: High-growth premium multiple collapsed as market repriced APL Apollo from an agile consumer brand to a conglomerate subsidiary with dilution overhang.

price_impact.mechanism: Institutional block selling and retail panic liquidation completely overwhelmed buy orders, breaking all support levels.
price_impact.session_behavior: Stock opened gap-down and was offered down through the day without finding support until ₹1,655.
price_impact.derivatives_impact: 1800 PE traded at ₹0.20–₹0.60 before news; surged to ₹145+ when spot touched ₹1,655 (+72,400% gain, ₹70,000+ profit per ₹100 invested).

option_setup.execution_warning: Historical Blueprint: 3-4 strikes deep OTM puts cost negligible capital (₹140/lot) but yield life-changing 700x returns when black-swan events unfold.

case_study_title: 🏛️ Benchmark Case Study: Sony Merger Termination (-33% Single-Day Crash / 160 PE +1,850% Surge)
source: NSE Corporate Disclosure & Historical Case Study
headline: Sony officially calls off $10 Billion merger with Zee Entertainment
details: Sony Group issued termination letter for the $10 billion mega-merger citing non-fulfillment of closing conditions and initiated arbitration seeking $90M termination fee. ZEEL stock crashed 33% in a single session from ₹245 to ₹152; 160 PE surged from ₹2.50 to ₹48.80 (+1,852%).

news_summary.key_event: Sony cancelled the 2-year-long $10B merger deal with Zee and demanded $90M in arbitration damages.
news_summary.financial_quantum: $10 Billion merger cancelled; $90M termination damages claimed by Sony.
news_summary.strategic_context: Loss of global distribution scale, leaving Zee vulnerable to intense domestic OTT streaming competition.

sentiment_analysis.rationale: Entire 2-year institutional investment thesis was predicated on Sony taking management control; termination triggered complete institutional exit.

price_impact.mechanism: Foreign portfolio investors and domestic mutual funds dumped shares unconditionally from the 09:00 AM pre-open session.
price_impact.session_behavior: Severe lower circuit halts throughout the day; bids disappeared across cash and futures.
price_impact.derivatives_impact: 160 PE spiked from ₹2.50 to ₹48.80 (+1,850%), delivering nearly 20x return on Put buyer capital.

option_setup.recommended_action: WATCH DEEP OTM PUTS ON DEAL CANCELLATION
option_setup.execution_warning: When mega M&A deals collapse over weekend/pre-market, OTM Puts 3-4 strikes below spot explode exponentially.
